title: Rust bitboard engine: parity gates and throughput benchmark vs TypeScript and C++ engines
hypothesis: Engineering port, no new science: a column-major nibble-packed Rust reimplementation of the Drop7 engine (7 x u32, 4 bits per cell; gravity as PEXT compaction; whole-board cover-hit counting with a bitboard adder) plus a packed-key transposition-table expectimax search is trace-equivalent to the frozen C++ reference (src/core/native/engine.hpp), the proven C++ fast engine (approaches/lifetime-objective/fast-engine, finding-13/audit-06), and the TypeScript engine (src/core/typescript/engine.ts): identical boards, scores, wave lists, reveal streams, leaf value bit patterns, per-column search values and chosen actions at fixed depth/strata. Expected speedup: at least the C++ fast engine's decisions/second at identical fixed work, with bounded per-searcher memory and near-linear game-level thread scaling; the realised figures are measured and reported with the machine profile. Per docs/benchmarks.md, any deviation in actions, random events, or work semantics reclassifies the port as a new algorithmic candidate and it is then not accepted under this record.

comparator.name: C++ fast engine + frozen native reference + TypeScript engine

data.reuseDisclosure: Zero new leased seeds. Trajectory and search gates read sub-blocks of the already-opened SEEDLEASE-A52-FAST development block 0xa5270000-0xa5277fff (docs/exploratory/lease-map.md, opened for semantics-preserving engine optimisation): Rust uses 0xa5276000-0xa5276fff (gates) and 0xa5277000-0xa5277fff (timing), disjoint from the C++ sub-blocks at 0xa5270000-0xa5275fff. CHECK probes may also read the already-open 0xa5278000-0xa52784ff probe block. No cohort's data status changes; no strength claim is made.

metrics.primary: trace equivalence vs the C++ reference and fast engine: board, score, next disc, wave list, reveal stream on every move; leaf value uint64 bit patterns; per-column search values and chosen actions at fixed depth/strata
secondary: moves and waves compared per gate configuration
decisions/second and games/second at d4s7 and d5s7 fixed work, Rust vs C++ fast vs C++ reference vs TypeScript
peak resident memory per searcher and per process
game-level thread scaling from 1 to 32 workers on the 16-core/32-thread host
worker-count independence of chosen actions in complete-depth mode
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: exact comparison; zero mismatches required; timing ratios from interleaved repeated best-of measurement on one machine profile

passCriteria: Trajectory gate: >= 4096 complete games per policy arm (center policy and a searching policy) replayed move-by-move through the Rust engine and the C++ reference/fast engine with 0 mismatches on board, next disc, score, score delta, wave list, level, moves remaining, terminal flag.
Leaf gate: >= 100,000 real leaf states with uint64-bit-identical leaf values vs the C++ fast leaf.

Search gate: >= 500 real root decisions at d4s7 and a d5s7 probe set with per-column double values bit-identical to the C++ fast search and identical chosen actions; identical completed depths at fixed work bounds.
Determinism: byte-identical chosen actions across worker counts (1 vs 32) in complete-depth mode and across repeated runs; reflection gate mirrors the C++ behavior.
TypeScript cross-check: >= 1000 games replayed through the TS engine and the Rust engine from the same Mulberry32 draw stream with identical boards and scores.
npm test and make test pass; no existing file is modified.
gate.failureAction: Record valid + fail as an engineering result; the C++ fast engine remains the fastest proven-equivalent implementation.
gate.passAction: Record valid + pass (engineering, CHECK tier) with measured throughput, memory and scaling figures and the machine profile; publish the comparative writeup as the approach page; no strength claim and no later cohort is opened by this record.

stopConditions: Stop on any equivalence mismatch that survives a bug-fix iteration on the SAME probe set; probe seeds are diagnostic and reusable for engineering equivalence, disclosed.
Stop at 4 h wall for the gate and benchmark runs; implementation time is not capped by this record.
No new leased seed may be opened under this record.
expectedArtifacts: runs/<run-id>/rust-engine/benchmark.json (per engine: decisions/second, games/second, memory, scaling; machine profile reference)
